Xuanyuan Domain |nation = Huanglong |region = }} The '''Celestials''' {{Lang|zh=天的}} are a conclave of [[Court of Savantae]] architects, artisans, and engineers who serve [[Sentinel]] [[Hsin]] by servicing, maintaining, and protecting [[Xuanfang Hold]]'s modular mechanisms in secrecy. Overseen by Hsin herself, they work and live in isolated sub-divisions across the multivarious regions of the Hold's Manifold Sanctum, with a prominent group based in the village of [[Mengxuan Vale]] in the [[Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou]]. Within the Simulacrum Nexus, their daily duties often consist of engineering work on its internal mechanisms and Inner Thresholds through the use of piloting Artisan Autopuppets. ==Overview== Existing as living, disembodied frequencies embedded in [[Xuanfang Hold]]'s core by Sentinel Hsin, the Celestials are members of the [[Court of Savantae]] who sacrificed their physical bodies as part of a contract with Hsin during the [[Fortress and Gorges War]], intended as a way for Hsin to maintain the secrets of the Hold's technology from [[Solaris-3]], due to Hsin fearing the dangers of advanced [[Sentinel]] technology being left in the hands of human civilization. ==History== ===The Founding of Xuanfang Hold=== The Celestials are eternally preserved frequencies whose origins date back to the [[Fortress and Gorges War]] in [[Huanglong]], over 200 years ago. In response to the growing threat of the [[Threnodian]] [[Ovathrax]]'s assault on the [[Jinzhou|border]], Hsin called a meeting at the [[Mengzhou]] City Hall between [[Zhuojun Atelier]] and the Mengzhou sect of the [[Court of Savantae]] in order to determine which of the two were best fit to lead the construction of Xuanfang Hold, which was conceptualized as a bastion for [[Xuanfang]] civilians to establish both a shelter and base of operations for the war effort. Hsin organized the meeting with [[Balanophora]], disguised as the then-Intendant of Sentinel Affairs, and overheard arguments from delegates of each group's congregation. After hearing from each faction, with the Atelier staging their argument on the basis that they were most fit to construct the Hold due to their knowledge of the local region, and the Court arguing that they were most equipped to closely study the advanced machinoform technologies of the Sentinel, Hsin ultimately chose the Court to lead the construction, and formed a contract with their organization. In truth, Hsin had already made her decision prior to the meeting, and was questioned by [[Balanophora]] regarding why she held the meeting despite this. Hsin explained that her goals were twofold; The first being that it was a public gesture of good faith meant to show the public that Mengzhou City Hall had a plan for the war, and the second being to confirm her fears of the Court being the true underlying threat out of the two factions. This was due to their dangerous thirst for knowledge potentially begetting an ulterior motive, which she sought to reign in ahead of time. The meeting with the Court's delegation was used to confirm her theory that that they would agree to sacrifice themselves in order to uphold the secrets of Hold from mortal eyes in exchange for being able to study the Sentinel's blueprint for the Hold, laying the foundations for what later became the Celestials. ===Compromised by Hsin's Assassination=== However, tragically, [[Balanophora]] followed Hsin to her quarters at the City Hall later that evening and attempted to assassinate Hsin, seizing the moment after years of lying in wait to conspire to kill her and sabotage Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule. The assassination would prove unsuccessful in the short-term, but left Hsin fatally wounded, with her energy destitute, weakened, and unable to recover, jeopardizing Xuanfang Hold's plans at its onset. Using a portion of her remaining energy, Hsin, the Moon Fox split herself into two fractal forms to uphold different aspects of her goals for Xuanfang Hold; [[Hsin]] and [[Suhsin]]. Hsin acted as an embodiment of the Moon Fox's humanity and emotions, entrusted with carrying out the Hold's construction with the Court of Savantae, while converting them into Celestials, while Suhsin was born as a logic algorithm who was entrusted with the duty of carrying out Xuanfang Hold's eventual collapse following the war. Hsin was also bade to ensure the repair of the Mengzhou Civilization Capsule, as a result of the damage it sustained from the [[Fractsidus]]'s attacks following their attempt on the Moon Fox's life. Hsin initially dutifully carried out the Hold's construction alongside the Court's teams of architects, while also purging the [[Fractsidus]]'s corruption from the Civilization Capsule that caused [[Tacet Discord]]s to attempt to sabotage the project. However, as a result of Hsin inadvertently draining the Moon Fox's last vestiges of energy to restore the Civilization Capsule and preserve it beyond its intended expiration date, the Moon Fox eventually succumbed to her injuries from the assassination. ===The Fortress and Gorges War=== In response to the growing construction of Xuanfang Hold, however, Ovathrax began a strategic intensification of the war that destructively ravaged the entire region in an attempt to destabilize the construction of the Hold. This would force Hsin's hand, as she rallied a war effort across the region consisting of forces from the newly established [[Jinzhou]], Autopuppets, Court of Savantae artisans, and [[Xuanfang Wardens]], who attempted to stave off the Threnodian's forces through a combination of counterattacks, humanitarian efforts, and wartime strategy. However, Ovathrax's forces resisted, overwhelming [[Xuanfang]] as [[Tacet Discord]] hordes began closing in on greater [[Mengzhou]]. Finally answering their call of action, a team of Court of Savantae artisans and troops partnered together in order to sacrifice themselves to trigger the self-destruction of [[Yuan Fortress]]' core, including [[Ruoyun]], driving out the bulk of Ovathrax's forces in the region. Many Court artisans lost their life in this detonation, leading to Hsin personally carrying out the work of elevating each member's frequency into a Celestial- even visiting Court artisans like Ruoyun in their dying moments to console them. ===Surviving Suhsin=== The Celestials, like Xuanfang Hold itself, survived the war in spirit, with their frequencies bound to the Hold as part of their contract to ensure its continued operations. Due to Hsin defying the Moon Fox's orders to collapse Xuanfang Hold, she would engage in a clandestine tug-of-war over her authority with her counterpart for the remaining two centuries. Gradually, she lost her authority and strength as she split her energy to preserve the Celestials' collective individuality across each of its members, while fending off Suhsin's growing coup, who severed herself from Hsin's authority outright. Suhsin violently besieged the [[Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou]], in an effort to use the Nexus Fox Shadow to carry out her original protocols, terrorizing many Celestials and remnant memories alike across the Simulacrum Nexus and its branching Heart Realms with a hostile army of rogue Autopuppets created by her; including units such as [[Formrender]]s, [[Soulfrayer]]s, [[Skywatch Lancer]]s, [[Bloomburst Puppet]]s, and [[Jade Nether Serpent]]s. Many Celestials lost their sanity to Suhsin's attacks across the Simulacrum Nexus destabilizing their essence, leading to them becoming Anomalies. This chaos eventually ended with the arrival of [[Rover]] and [[Suoming]], who worked together to locate and free Hsin, before overthrowing Suhsin and reclaiming both Hsin's authority, along with her control over the Nexus Fox Shadow. Hsin made peace with Suhsin after defeating her alongside Rover and Suoming, and Suhsin found herself moved by Hsin's plea for her to let go of her misanthropic outlook towards the Celestials and humanity's preservation in the Sanctum, instead encouraging her to trust in her faith that the endurance and perseverance of the human condition exhibited by the Celestials was proof enough to maintain their existence.{{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}} ==Members== ===Xuanyuan Domain=== {| class="article-table" !Icon!!Personnel!!Position |- |[[File:Ruoyun Icon.png|75px]] |[[Ruoyun]] |Xuanyuan Domain Engineer{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} |} ===Simulacrum Nexus=== {| class="article-table" !Icon!!Personnel!!Position |- |[[File:Leyue Icon.png|50px]] |[[Leyue]] |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- |[[File:Mingxiao Icon.png|50px]] |[[Mingxiao]] |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Huaiqi |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Yiwen |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Yunqu |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Qing Yan |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Yanqiu |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Xitong |Simulacrum Nexus Staffer |- | |Luojing |Simulacrum Nexus Engineer |} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Celestial |zhs = 天的 |zht = 天的 |ja = 天空の |ko = 천상의 |fr = Céleste |de = Himmelsbewohner |es = Celeste |th = ท้องฟ้า |pt = Celestial }} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{Faction Navbox}}
